title: How is Hitler connected to Hatsune Miku?
description: Six real pictures connect Adolf Hitler to Hatsune Miku, through a former king, three presidents and a late-night host.
hook: How is Adolf Hitler connected to Hatsune Miku?

image.file: File:Duc et duchesse de Windsor avec Hitler (1937).jpg

links.line: In 1937, Hitler welcomed Britain's former king, Edward VIII.
In 1970, President Richard Nixon hosted Edward and his wife at the White House.

image.file: File:Richard Nixon with George H. W. Bush.jpg

links.line: That year, Nixon picked a young George Bush as his ambassador to the United Nations.

image.file: File:George H. W. Bush and Barack Obama present the 5,000th Daily Point of Light Award.jpg

links.line: In 2013, Bush joined Barack Obama at the White House to honor volunteers.

image.file: File:2012 President Barack Obama with David Letterman.jpg

links.line: Back in 2012, Obama sat down with David Letterman on the Late Show.

image.credit: CBS / Late Show with David Letterman (via Grantland)

links.line: And in 2014, Letterman shared his stage with Hatsune Miku, live as a hologram.
